subject: Error: some variables have no variance

messages.author: 8b4c0cb7eca9d6b9
messages.subject: Error: some variables have no variance
parts:
Hi,

I am new to SEM and lavaan so I apologise in advance for probably asking very basic questions.

I'm trying to run a SEM but lavaan shows this error message: "lavaan ERROR: some variables have no values (only missings) or no variance"

I checked my database and found that all variables have variance. I think the issue is related to how lavaan reads the data.

So I kindly ask if you can give me some recommendations to follow if any of you have gone through cases like this in the past.

Thanks in advance

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Error: some variables have no variance
parts: I checked my database and found that all variables have variance.

lavaan's default option for missing data is listwise deletion, so you would need to check your subset of complete data.

myVars <- c("store","all","variable","names","included","in","your","model")
dat.comp <- dat[complete.cases(dat), myVars]
sapply(dat.comp, sd)
